verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity's 'Flows' let ops teams save and reuse a verification configuration (document types, branding, verification limits) across integration points without redeploying code, and review tools allow manual override/blocklisting — some no-code configurability exists. However there is no evidence of no-code conditional branching, risk-based routing, or country-specific requirement rules being configurable by an ops lead outside engineering. missing for 10: conditional-step configuration, risk-based routing logic, country-specific requirement customization, and any UI/console screenshot showing these settings.
